summary: Master RegTech and compliance automation in 5 days. Learn GRC platforms, AML workflows, KYC automation, and regulatory reporting. Enroll at TrainingCred.
lede: RegTech and compliance automation helps compliance and risk teams move from manual checks to data-driven oversight. This intermediate course is for professionals modernizing compliance operations, with practical work in mapping compliance data flows, configuring transaction-monitoring rules, and developing risk-scoring models. It also covers API integration, automated identity checks, digital reporting, privacy workflows, and phased vendor implementation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is essential for professionals tasked with modernizing the compliance and risk functions within their organizations.
audience: Financial Crime Investigator using AI-powered surveillance
Digital Transformation Lead focused on compliance
modules: Compliance Data Architecture and API Integration
Automated Identity Verification and KYC Workflows
Data Privacy Automation and GDPR Compliance
Digital Regulatory Reporting and XBRL Standards
Machine Learning for Predictive Compliance Risk
Blockchain Applications for Immutable Audit Trails
RegTech Ecosystem and Vendor Integration Strategy
Strategic Implementation and Executive Compliance Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience in compliance, risk management, or internal audit. A basic understanding of regulatory frameworks and familiarity with standard office data tools is required. No prior programming knowledge is necessary, though an interest in digital transformation is essential.
